Title: LSJ: Dual form effect, combat or not?

Messages.Author: talonz
Messages.Body:
Dual form triggers an effect (burn the other DF minion) when one of the
DF minions is no longer ready. If the non-ready DF minion was
burned/torporized in combat, is this effect treated and resolved as if
during that combat?

I'm guessing no, because once a minion in combat is no longer ready
combat ends? But want to check on the exact sequence.

G

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct. If the first minion saves himself (with Undead Persistence,
for example), then the effect (burn buddy from Dual Form) is not
triggered (well, at least it is delayed in the Undead Persistence
case).

The buddy burn only occurs once the vampire is not ready (and combat
has therefore ended).

Messages.Author: Wolflord
Messages.Body:
Okay,
So, this like, becomes really cool when Dual Form Buddies start to
Reform Body?
Or could you not do that if you controll the Dual Forms and are in your
own turn, since they are not the one in combat, and it's a reaction
card?

/jo

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The combatant buddy can Reform Body as a combat card.

The non-combatant buddy can Reform Body as areaction card if he is
untapped and the acting minion is controlled by another Methuselah
(typically meaning it is that other Methuselah's turn, but that isn't
always the case thanks to Madness Network -- so the key is "who is
acting" not "whose turn is it").
